title: Calls and messages
lead: Is lesson ke baad tum video call start kar sakte ho, bad network handle kar sakte ho, screen share kar sakte ho, aur call ke baad message se follow-up kar sakte ho.
description: Week 7 English lesson: start a call, handle a bad connection, share a screen, reschedule, and follow up by message.

patterns.note: Call ki pehli line — audio check.
patterns.question: Can you hear me now?
examples: Can you hear me now?
Ab aap mujhe sun sakte hain?
Sorry, I can't hear you. The audio is breaking.
Sorry, main aapko sun nahi pa raha. Audio cut ho raha hai.
patterns.grammar: hear = sunna (kaan se aana); listen = dhyan se sunna. Call check ke liye Can you hear me?
patterns.mistake: “Are you hearing me?” → “Can you hear me?” Hear ke saath can use karo.

patterns.say: I'm on a call right now.
patterns.positive: I'm on a call right now.
patterns.question: Are you on a call?
examples: I'm on a call. Can I call you back?
Main call par hoon. Kya main baad me call kar sakta hoon?
She's in a meeting right now.
Woh abhi meeting me hai.
patterns.grammar: on a call = call par busy; in a meeting = meeting me. State hai, isliye present continuous.
patterns.mistake: “I'm in call” → “I'm on a call.” on a call fixed phrase.

patterns.negative: I can't share my screen right now.
patterns.question: Can you share your screen?
examples: Let me share my screen and show you the design.
Main screen share karke aapko design dikhata hoon.
Can you see my screen?
Kya aap meri screen dekh sakte hain?
patterns.grammar: Let me + base verb = main karta hoon (offer). share my screen.
patterns.mistake: “Let me to share my screen” → “Let me share my screen.” let me ke baad base verb.

patterns.note: Baad me call karne ka promise.
patterns.say: I'll call you back in ten minutes.
patterns.positive: I'll call you back in ten minutes.
patterns.negative: I won't be able to call you back today.
patterns.question: Can I call you back?
examples: I'll call you back after lunch.
Main lunch ke baad call back karunga.
Can I call you back in five minutes?
Kya main paanch minute me call back kar sakta hoon?
patterns.grammar: call back = dobara call karna. will for promise. in + duration (in ten minutes).
patterns.mistake: “I'll call you back after ten minutes” → “I'll call you back in ten minutes.” in = duration ke baad.

patterns.note: File ya message bhejne ke baad follow-up.
patterns.say: Please check your email. I've sent the file.
patterns.positive: Please check your email. I've sent the file.
patterns.question: Did you get my email?
examples: Please check your WhatsApp. I've sent the photo.
Please WhatsApp check karo. Maine photo bhej di hai.
I've sent the invoice. Please check your email.
Maine invoice bhej diya hai. Please email check karo.
patterns.grammar: Please + base verb. check your email/WhatsApp. I've sent = just sent.
patterns.mistake: “Please check your email box” → “Please check your email.” email box ki zaroorat nahi.

patterns.question: Is the connection okay?
examples: Sorry, the connection is bad. Can you repeat that?
Sorry, connection kharab hai. Kya aap dobara bol sakte hain?
The connection is better now. Can you hear me?
Ab connection better hai. Sunai de raha hai?
patterns.grammar: connection is bad/poor/unstable. Sorry + statement. Blame network, not person.
patterns.mistake: “My connection is badly” → “The connection is bad.” Bad adjective, badly adverb.

dialogue.context: Video call, network thoda weak. Riya = client. Audio check, screen share aur follow-up cover karo.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Hi Riya. Yes, I can hear you, but the connection is a little bad.

lines.speaker: Riya
lines.text: Should I call you on WhatsApp?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Let me try my headphones first. Okay, can you hear me now?

lines.speaker: Riya
lines.text: Yes, much better. Let me share my screen.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Great, I can see it. I'll send you the notes after the call.

dialogue.closing: Call ke teen checkpoints: audio, screen, next step. Har call ke end me follow-up message bolo.

speakPrompts.title: 1. Start a call
speakPrompts.starter: Hi, can you hear me? ... Great. Let's start with ___ .

speakPrompts.title: 2. Bad network
speakPrompts.starter: Sorry, the connection is bad. Can you repeat that? ... Let me call you back in ___ .

speakPrompts.title: 3. Share your screen
speakPrompts.starter: Let me share my screen. Can you see it?

speakPrompts.title: 4. Follow-up message
speakPrompts.starter: Hi ___ , thanks for the call. Please check your email. I'll call you back on ___ .

Call ke end me next step clear bola.

pronunciation.title: Phone clarity
pronunciation.body: Final consonants clear rakho: hearD, senD, calL. Phone par ending chhup jati hai.

pronunciation.title: Pausing
pronunciation.body: Ek saans me sab mat bolo. “Sorry — the connection is bad — can you repeat that?” Har dash par chhota pause.

pronunciation.title: can / can't
pronunciation.body: can = /kən/ halka; can't = /kɑːnt/ clear. Phone par can't ko zyada clear bolo.

pronunciation.title: Linking
pronunciation.body: call you back → /kɔːljuːbæk/. “meet you” → /miːtʃuː/. Natural speech me words jodte hain.

followUps: Phone par kaunse phrases sabse clear lagte hain?

mission: Make one real call in English, or record a 2-minute mock call with audio check, screen share, and follow-up.
